query:
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
'identity', jsonb_build_object('database',current_database(),'read_only',current_setting('transaction_read_only'),'version',current_setting('server_version'),'role',current_user),
'objects',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',c.relname,'kind',c.relkind,'rls',c.relrowsecurity,'force_rls',c.relforcerowsecurity,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner)) ORDER BY c.relname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname IN ('alert_episodes','ingestion_runs','alert_episode_sources','ingestion_checkpoints','current_ingestion_checkpoints','attack_event_classifications','attack_event_sources','attack_events')),
'columns',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',c.relname,'name',a.attname,'type',pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),'nullable',NOT a.attnotnull,'default',pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid),'identity',a.attidentity,'generated',a.attgenerated) ORDER BY c.relname,a.attnum),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid=a.attrelid AND d.adnum=a.attnum WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname IN ('alert_episodes','ingestion_runs','alert_episode_sources','ingestion_checkpoints','current_ingestion_checkpoints','attack_event_classifications','attack_event_sources','attack_events') AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped),
'constraints',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',c.relname,'name',co.conname,'type',co.contype,'def',pg_catalog.pg_get_constraintdef(co.oid,true),'deferred',co.condeferrable) ORDER BY c.relname,co.conname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint co JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.oid=co.conrelid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname IN ('alert_episodes','ingestion_runs','alert_episode_sources','ingestion_checkpoints','current_ingestion_checkpoints','attack_event_classifications','attack_event_sources','attack_events')),
'indexes',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',t.relname,'name',i.relname,'unique',x.indisunique,'primary',x.indisprimary,'def',pg_catalog.pg_get_indexdef(i.oid)) ORDER BY t.relname,i.relname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_catalog.pg_index x JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class t ON t.oid=x.indrelid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class i ON i.oid=x.indexrelid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND t.relname IN ('alert_episodes','ingestion_runs','alert_episode_sources','ingestion_checkpoints','current_ingestion_checkpoints','attack_event_classifications','attack_event_sources','attack_events')),
'triggers',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',c.relname,'name',t.tgname,'enabled',t.tgenabled,'def',pg_catalog.pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid,true),'function',nf.nspname||'.'||f.proname) ORDER BY c.relname,t.tgname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger t JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace JOIN pg_catalog.pg_proc f ON f.oid=t.tgfoid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace nf ON nf.oid=f.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND c.relname IN ('alert_episodes','ingestion_runs','alert_episode_sources','ingestion_checkpoints','current_ingestion_checkpoints','attack_event_classifications','attack_event_sources','attack_events')),
'policies',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',tablename,'policy',policyname,'cmd',cmd,'qual',qual,'check',with_check)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_catalog.pg_policies WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename IN ('alert_episodes','ingestion_runs','alert_episode_sources','ingestion_checkpoints','current_ingestion_checkpoints','attack_event_classifications','attack_event_sources','attack_events')),
'extensions',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',extname,'version',extversion) ORDER BY extname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_catalog.pg_extension)
) AS inventory

constraints.def: CHECK (qa_reasons_state = 'MATERIALIZED'::text AND jsonb_typeof(qa_reasons) = 'array'::text OR qa_reasons_state = 'UNMATERIALIZED_IN_ACCEPTED_SOURCE'::text AND qa_reasons IS NULL)

constraints.name: ingestion_checkpoints_observed_interval_check

constraints.def: CHECK (checkpoint_seq = 1 AND previous_checkpoint_id IS NULL OR checkpoint_seq > 1 AND previous_checkpoint_id IS NOT NULL)

constraints.def: CHECK (ingest_committed_at IS NULL OR finished_at IS NULL OR ingest_committed_at <= finished_at)

constraints.def: CHECK (ingest_committed_at IS NULL OR ingest_committed_at >= started_at)
constraints.name: ingestion_runs_commit_time_check

constraints.def: CHECK (finished_at IS NULL OR finished_at >= started_at)
constraints.name: ingestion_runs_finished_time_check

constraints.def: CHECK (status = 'running'::text AND finished_at IS NULL OR status <> 'running'::text AND finished_at IS NOT NULL)
constraints.name: ingestion_runs_status_time_check

constraints.def: CHECK (status <> 'succeeded'::text OR ingest_committed_at IS NOT NULL)
constraints.name: ingestion_runs_succeeded_commit_check
